name: po.test
title: Phillips-Ouliaris statistic on two columns, with the longer lag.

origin.description: Phillips-Ouliaris statistic on two columns, with the longer lag.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Phillips-Ouliaris statistic on two columns, with the longer lag.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
x <- sin((1:40)/3) + 0.1 * (1:40)
y <- cos((1:40)/5)
po <- po.test(cbind(x, y), lshort = FALSE)
paste(cell(po$statistic), cell(po$p.value), po$parameter, sep = "|")

translation.description: Phillips-Ouliaris statistic on two columns, with the longer lag.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: Phillips-Ouliaris statistic on two columns, with the longer lag.
translation.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
translation.example:
x = np.array([math.sin(i / 3) + 0.1 * i for i in range(1, 41)])
y = np.array([math.cos(i / 5) for i in range(1, 41)])
po = po_test(np.column_stack([x, y]), lshort=False)
return "|".join([cell(po["statistic"]), cell(po["p_value"]), str(po["parameter"])])
